text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is Yukino Bijin's signature racewear photo shoot. I'm watching with Sakura Bakushin O, who is scheduled for today as well.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um, oh geez… Smile, smile… L-like this?!

text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff
text_block_list.text: Uh… yeah! That's fine! Try to relax your shoulders a little bit more!
choice_data_list: There's nothing to be nervous about.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Just watch me, Yukino! I'm top of the class when it comes to keeping it cool! Fix your posture, put on a bright smile, and relax! Easy breeeezy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: O-okay! S-stand straight… smile, then… relax… Easy! Breezy!

text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff
text_block_list.text: Um, how about we take a little break?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Nngh… I'm hopeless… And Bakushin O's s'posed to go after me too. Ohhh, what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's like I had this outfit 'specially designed around all my fav'rite things for noth'n.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh… My racewear's chocked full o' things y'can see back in in my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The designer asked me what kinda things I liked for reference, so I just started list'n stuff off…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Your hometown, eh? Morioka, was it? I've heard much about it in my geography class! It snows a whole bunch there, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You bet it does. That's why we made my racewear white as snow!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanted it t'be snow white, a bit fluffy… and accented with dark blue, like how the snow looks in shadow…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And these li'l embroidered flowers are based on the flowers that bloom right at the start of spring when the snow melts… They're pretty as all get-out.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I even talked it over with my fam'ly on the phone, and my sister suggested the ice crystal on the choker!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And my dad just said I'll look good in anyth'n, so I should just wear what I want and race my heart out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wow! That was pretty cool of him! Wear what you want and Bakushin your heart out! I think that's the best advice there is.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I've been think'n this for a while, but… you and my dad might be kinda sim'lar!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, I was smil'n just now, wasn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's it! I've got it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Welcome to "Bakushin Q and A: Hometown Edition!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: O-okay! Ask me anyth'n you want about Morioka!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Question one! What's a popular place to visit at Morioka Station?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Umm… the waterfall at the bus station! There're always tons of cute li'l doves over there too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Question two! What's a delicious snack made in Morioka?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Easy-peasy! Rice crackers're a surefire winner! We've even got sweet and soft'uns!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, there's also yuzu dumpl'ns and snacks made from apples! Morioka's full of yummy treats! They're super-duper scrum-diddly-umptious!

text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff
text_block_list.text: That's it! Keep it coming, just like that!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank you both for all the help today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Don't mention it! It's all in a day's work for a class rep! Just glad I could help!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehehe… Sorry for tak'n up so much time, but thanks to you two, I managed t'get some pictures everyone back home'll be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehehe… Sorry for tak'n up so much time, but thanks to you two, I managed t'get some pictures everyone back home'll be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks! It was kinda hard, but think'n about back home always makes me smile!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So you derive strength and cheer from your home! How lovely!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's right! And now I know that if I'm hav'n a hard time, all I've gotta do is think of home. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I agree! These photos deserve an A plus! They show just how bright and awesome you are!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aw, shucks! Heap this much praise on me and I'm likely t'die of embarrassment! …Hehehe!
